responsibility: Implements the region hierarchy that represents abstract memory objects for the analyzer. It provides shared region logic such as base-region discovery, descendant and frame queries, memory-space classification, initial-value eligibility, offsets and sizes, and pretty-printing, together with concrete behavior for specialized region subclasses like casts, heap and alloca allocations, string literals, bit ranges, varargs, errno, and fallback unknown regions.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line behavior for the region class hierarchy from region.h, such as base-region discovery, memory-space classification, offset/size queries, and subclass-specific dumping/visitation, rather than defining the region kinds, class layouts, and uniquing keys themselves.
